title: Collatz: actual scalar, arbitrary carry returns, and denominator rigidity
body:
## New checkpoint: arbitrary carry returns and complete denominator rigidity

**Collatz remains OPEN.** The previous checkpoint constructs the actual discounted scalar and proves that its triadic arithmetic is equivalent to convergence. This checkpoint controls every first excursion in the remaining denominator-eight phase, extends the denominator exclusions to complete mixed denominators, and establishes an actual-source distribution theorem. The global carry-control construction remains missing.

- **Published head:** c369ae3c426ec6aaf9a280ec9578b9910c2147d5
- **Tree:** 269c610dac69cd8fa740a4f32dab452a05aa1d42
- **Single parent:** 6352608dd6c04735e1f8bd86fef4ebc97b1aeacb
- [Scientific overview](https://github.com/GettysburgResearch/collatz/blob/c369ae3c426ec6aaf9a280ec9578b9910c2147d5/research/scalar-rigidity-round9-20261123/README.md) · [verification report](https://github.com/GettysburgResearch/collatz/blob/c369ae3c426ec6aaf9a280ec9578b9910c2147d5/reports/2026-11-23-scalar-rigidity-round9/README.md) · [exact source and literature ledger](https://github.com/GettysburgResearch/collatz/blob/c369ae3c426ec6aaf9a280ec9578b9910c2147d5/research/scalar-rigidity-round9-20261123/SOURCES.json)
- 30 additive files; all **617 parent files**, including all **56 earlier Lean files**, preserved unchanged.

### Strongest new deterministic result

For the actual denominator-eight phases, write `h_i=p_i+k_i`, where `p_i` alternates between `7/8,5/8` and the integer carry is nonnegative. The complete physical and scalar equations give

`Y_i=q_i/2^k_i; Y_(i+1)=3Y_i/2^(b_i+2k_i)+1/2^(b_i+3k_i).`

The destination carry disappears. Every positive current carry is bounded by a unit-carry affine map. **R9-C2 bounds every normalized first paid excursion, at arbitrary length and carry size:**

`r <= P(x)=(9x+5)/32 <= x/3.`

A longer excursion satisfies `r <= (81x+605)/1024 < P(x)`. R9-C3 supplies the finite actual return budget `2 bl(q+7)+1`. R9-C4 extends descent after up to ten unpaid `(2,1)` pairs to **every** paid excursion. The complete two-block source class has a sharp descent/expansion boundary at ten/eleven unpaid pairs.

The hypothetical global least source with actual `h(q)=7/8` must have `v_2(q+7) in {34,37,40,...}`, `q != 2 mod 9`, and `v_3(16q+29)<=23`. An explicit infinite integer family satisfies all three gates, so no contradiction from those congruences is claimed.

A supplied `a/(8*3^r)` has a bounded reduction to a triadic dispatch, sound rejection, or a `7/8` candidate. The implemented one-return transformer preserves equality; its returned candidate is not an acceptance.

[Complete proof and interfaces](https://github.com/GettysburgResearch/collatz/blob/c369ae3c426ec6aaf9a280ec9578b9910c2147d5/research/scalar-rigidity-round9-20261123/CARRY_RETURN.md) · [finite Lean core](https://github.com/GettysburgResearch/collatz/blob/c369ae3c426ec6aaf9a280ec9578b9910c2147d5/research/scalar-rigidity-round9-20261123/CarryReturn.lean)

### Complete denominator rigidity and its sharp boundary

**R9-P1–P2:** full residue-fiber averaging applies to arbitrary complete residual denominators, not separately to their factors. For fixed odd prime support P, with `t_p=ord_p(3)`, `w_p=v_p(3^t_p-1)`, and `ell_p=max_(q!=p)v_p(t_q)`, every surviving denominator obeys

`v_p(d)<=w_p+ell_p; v_2(d)<=3+max_q v_2(t_q).`

Thus only finitely many residual denominators remain for each fixed support. The binary boundary retains the parent's explicitly verified ordinary floor through 31.

**R9-P3:** the exact doubling-defect identity excludes every complete odd denominator dividing some `3^j-2`. A qualified complete Gauss-sum estimate also gives a prime-only large-coset exclusion.

**R9-P4–P5:** the remaining boundary is real. The family `d=2(3^N-1)`, N>=6, has low phase mean `3/4+1/(4N)` and meets every forward pressure-clock inequality. At N=6, d=1456 attains the support cap for {7,13}. Positive ordinary finite cylinders approach the target scalars, while the periodic rational realization is negative. No infinite positive counterexample is inferred.

[Complete phase proofs](https://github.com/GettysburgResearch/collatz/blob/c369ae3c426ec6aaf9a280ec9578b9910c2147d5/research/scalar-rigidity-round9-20261123/PHASE_RIGIDITY.md) · [independent review](https://github.com/GettysburgResearch/collatz/blob/c369ae3c426ec6aaf9a280ec9578b9910c2147d5/reports/2026-11-23-scalar-rigidity-round9/PHASE_REVIEW.md)

### Same maximum, actual source law, and literature boundary

- **R9-M1:** at the **same attained pressure maximum**, if its scalar has reduced denominator exactly eight with no ternary factor, then `h(m)=5/8` and `v_2(m+5) in {26,29,32,...}`. The complete first-return clock supplies the exact obstruction `2^27>3^17`. This source is not identified with the global least `7/8` source, and the maximum is not moved after ternary clearing. [Source-qualified corollary](https://github.com/GettysburgResearch/collatz/blob/c369ae3c426ec6aaf9a280ec9578b9910c2147d5/research/scalar-rigidity-round9-20261123/MAXIMUM_GATE.md).
- **R9-L1–L5:** the empirical distribution of actual h(q) over odd q<=X tends to the discounted independent geometric law, with an explicit bounded Lipschitz error estimate. The limit is singular continuous. For every fixed positive D, sources with `h(q) in D^(-1)Z` have density zero. This is compatible with every actual h(q) being triadic; no countable-union or fixed-orbit randomness inference is made. [Actual-source law](https://github.com/GettysburgResearch/collatz/blob/c369ae3c426ec6aaf9a280ec9578b9910c2147d5/research/scalar-rigidity-round9-20261123/ACTUAL_SCALAR_LAW.md).
- **R9-A1–A4:** arbitrary binary carry scripts can have positive bounded nonperiodic automatic gaps and discounted value exactly `7/8`. Every finite word has a literal ordinary realization. More generally actual scalar values approximate every target >=1/2 in every fixed odd congruence class, with explicit source-height and error bounds. The sources change with the precision. [Arithmetic construction and obstruction](https://github.com/GettysburgResearch/collatz/blob/c369ae3c426ec6aaf9a280ec9578b9910c2147d5/research/scalar-rigidity-round9-20261123/ARITHMETIC_RIGIDITY.md).

Primary texts by Tao, Solomyak, Adamczewski–Bugeaud, Corvaja–Zannier, and Kurlberg were inspected at the stated theorem boundaries. The symbolic gap digits are redundant, and the proposed radical/S-unit relation cancels back to the original ordinary equation. No missing height, noncancellation, or normalization hypothesis is silently imported.

- Independent frozen reviews reconstruct the actual law, arithmetic construction, complete phase arguments, maximum gate, and all-carry return proof. [Root review](https://github.com/GettysburgResearch/collatz/blob/c369ae3c426ec6aaf9a280ec9578b9910c2147d5/reports/2026-11-23-scalar-rigidity-round9/ROOT_REVIEW.md).
- The clean local science checkout and the freshly fetched **published 647-file checkout** both passed all five required repository-integrity commands.
- Fresh remote ref and PR reads confirmed this exact head after the nonforced update. All 645 science-tree source bindings and all 617 parent files were checked again in the fetched checkout.
- Published gate receipt SHA256: `429dda00df23ac5fca338087710749d54bbbfaa3f4a2d2ded96f988525e5d8b7`.
- In-tree source binding SHA256: `8001d0705e004cc4b8da08d6da922c56c4bf9edefdd2b31eec405eb2dc3ee2d5`.

The Lean cores cover finite arithmetic, affine comparisons, and clocks. The real series, full actual attachment, probability/measure arguments, CRT existence, and modular group theorems remain written mathematics. Finite test counts overlap and are not counts of distinct sources or universal proofs. Repository-integrity success is not mathematical verification.

### Remaining global obligation

Control the unbounded sequence of actual returns with long unpaid prefixes, or construct the actual scalar's triadic arithmetic for each unchanged positive ordinary source. Fixed-support finiteness still leaves arbitrary prime supports and irrational scalar values. The local return theorem does not supply a globally decreasing rank.

[Precise next obligations](https://github.com/GettysburgResearch/collatz/blob/c369ae3c426ec6aaf9a280ec9578b9910c2147d5/reports/2026-11-23-scalar-rigidity-round9/HANDOFF.md).
